Name: Warp Hall (Content Patcher)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[b][size=5]General[/size][/b]
If you've always had trouble including the warp obelisks into your farm layout, I may have a solution for you! This content pack for Content Patcher adds a new farm building for construction at the wizard's tower after completing the magic ink quest: a configurable warp hall that allows you to access all warp points from the comfort of a single room. 

From the outside, the warp hall looks like a regular building, designed to blend in with its environment. There are several visual options available to match with different aesthetics and recolor mods. You can also choose for the building to change to a snowy version during winter.
The building interior contains warp statutes to all four vanilla warp locations.

[b]Extra Warps (optional)[/b]
You can choose to add a few more warp statues to your warp hall: Town, Forest (near the traveling cart) and Volcano.

[b]Good to know[/b]
Using the default warp method (ObeliskWarp), SMAPI will flag an 'unknown warp property' error message upon loading the save file. This is normal for the used tile property and has no effect on the game. If you find it annoying, you can opt for the MagicWarp method instead (see configurations).

[b]Switching configurations mid-save[/b]
If you decide to use a different interior layout or warp method after building the warp hall, make sure to remove any items you placed near the statues inside the building before doing so. The statues are placed slightly differently in each layout and may clip into placed objects. The building's exterior can be changed at any time without precautions.

[b]Reaching perfection[/b]
As of right now, the warp hall does not count towards perfection in regards to the warp obelisks. I'm looking into potential ways to fix this, but for the time being, you will have to build the obelisks separately if you want to reach perfection.

[b][size=5]Configurations 
[/size][/b]Using Generic Mod Config Menu, you can make the following configurations:
[size=4]Aesthetics [/size]
[list]
[*]WinterTexture - whether to add snow and ice to the building during winter.
[*]ShortBuilding - shortens the building to take up less visual space.
[*]ExteriorTexture - changes how the building looks on the outside, as showcased in the images tab of this mod page. Options: Default, Earthy, Blue, Medieval
[*]InteriorTexture - color variations for the interior map of the building. Options: Default, Earthy, Blue
[/list][size=4]Mechanics [/size]
[list]
[*]Construction - the amount of money and resources required to build the warp hall. Options listed below. 
[*]WarpMethod - whether to teleport by clicking on the warp statues (ObeliskWarp) or by stepping on the tile in front of them (MagicWarp).
[*]AdditionalWarps - whether to add the three additional warp statues (forest, town, volcano)
[/list]
[size=4][u]Construction Options[/u]
[/size]Cheap:
- 1,000,000g, 10 coconuts, 5 bananas, 10 coral, 5 earth crystals, 10 iridium bars

Default:
- 3,000,000g, 1 prismatic shard, 10 coconuts, 10 bananas, 10 coral, 10 earth crystals, 30 iridium bars

Expensive:
- 5,000,000g, 5 prismatic shards, 20 coconuts, 10 bananas, 20 coral, 10 earth crystals, 50 iridium bars

Capitalist:
- 10,000,000g, 10 prismatic shards, 50 coconuts, 20 dragon teeth, 10 rainbow shells, 20 radioactive bars, 100 iridium bars

[size=5][b]Compatibility [/b][/size]
There should be no compatibility issues with most mods, the warp points are usually not affected by mod changes.
However, if you are using a mod that alters the structure/size of the warpable maps, the warp points may be misplaced on the affected maps. You can resolve this by opening the warp hall's interior map in tiled and adjusting the warp coordinates in the tile property objects. You can refer to the Stardew Valley Wiki map modding article to help you do this. If you're still stuck, you can also message me here or on Discord (@yuninocorn) for help. 

[size=5][b]Future Plans[/b][/size]
I'm planning to add the following features in upcoming versions of this mod if I am able to do so:
- make the warp hall count as the obelisks for perfection
- a building upgrade that allows the warp hall to function as the golden clock
- a warp monument that combines all of the warp statues on the exterior for a single clean structure with no interior 
- additional interior room options like a mini spa room for those who like to optimize their space
- different aesthetic layouts for the interior and exterior of the building
- an option to add warp points to locations from popular expansion mods 

Enjoy the mod!
